description: Machine-readable ownership for 015-governance-depth-convergence. Each packet declares coder-write surfaces (globs a swarm coder may edit), shared surfaces (read/merge by multiple coders, never exclusively owned), and orchestrator-only surfaces (must not be edited by a coder bot). Validation rejects overlapping coder surfaces, coder edits to orchestrator-only surfaces, direct edits to generated files, and missing per-packet validation.
